title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored reserve, geometry-constrained Swiss lever release, and a state-integrated balance/hairspring oscillator with explicit angle, angular velocity, restoring force, damping, impulse kicks, and amplitude-dependent rate.

facts.Current pass: M5f reserve → impulse Δω + hairspring restoring/damping → integrated θ/ω → geometry-constrained escapement → train
